OFFICIAL | NETO IS A JUVENTUS PLAYERNorberto Neto is back in a Juventus shirt. The Brazilian goalkeeper returns to the Bianconeri, signing a deal until 30 June 2027.Born in 1989, Neto previously represented Juventus between 2015 and 2017, making 22 appearances across two seasons and winning two Serie A titles, two Coppa Italia trophies and one Italian Super Cup.After his time in Turin, the Brazilian goalkeeper continued his international career, spending five years in Spain with Valencia and Barcelona, followed by three seasons in England with Bournemouth and Arsenal, before returning to Brazil last season with Botafogo.Welcome back to Juventus, Norberto![Juventus]

💰 TuttoSport has published the complete list of player salaries of the #Juventus squad.According to the newspaper, €106M, or slightly more, is the total amount that #Juve spends every year, including bonuses, to cover the wages of the team.More than €1.6M per week, to which additional bonuses must be added.The list does not include #Miretti, #JoaoMario, #Openda, #DiGregorio and #Adzic, who are out on loan and whose salaries are not paid by the bianconero club.The official figures for Norberto #Neto's salary are not yet known, but it will certainly be under one million euros, making it one of the least burdensome contracts in the squad.Among the lowest on the table is Carlo #Pinsoglio with €0
